collection.title: Porsche 911 Targa 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Porsche 911 Targa 2019 Onwards (992) will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 23" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Porsche 911 Targa 2022 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
